h1: Window cleaning in The Reserve at Lake Travis
intro: The Reserve at Lake Travis is a gated waterfront community on 310 acres, at the far northwest edge of our area. CleanzATX cleans windows here with pure water, and we plan visits around the drive and the gate.

sections.h2: What Reserve at Lake Travis homes are like
paragraphs: The Reserve is a gated resort style community of 310 acres, with roughly 400 lots. Homes have three to six bedrooms on lots up to an acre, priced from about $1M to $5M. Amenities include a marina, a yacht club, a swim park with a lazy river, a restaurant and stables, and a Reserve at Lake Travis HOA runs the grounds. Houses lean large and detailed, with stone, stucco and metal roofs, wide patios and long glass walls facing the water or the hills. This is the far northwest edge of the area we serve, so a visit takes planning.
A community like this has a lot of glass, and much of it faces the lake.

sections.h2: What Reserve at Lake Travis windows deal with
paragraphs: Waterfront glass has the hardest job. Spray and humidity from the lake leave a mineral haze, and west facing windows catch low sun that reveals every streak. Irrigation over large lawns and the resort landscaping leaves hard water scale on lower panes that can etch if it is left for years. Cedar pollen in winter and live oak pollen in spring cover surfaces, and the stables and open land nearby add dust. Decks and patios under the windows get foot traffic that kicks dust up on the glass.
Tall walls of glass also gather webs and insects around the frames, mainly near trees and lights.

sections.h2: How we work Reserve at Lake Travis
paragraphs: The gate is the first step. Send us the code or the contact who can open it, and we confirm arrival by text. Because it is a drive from Bee Cave, we group stops, so neighbors who book the same day make the trip more efficient. Our skid carries 200 gallons for the pure water system. Water fed poles reach up to three stories from the ground, which handles tall lakeside elevations without ladders on stone or stucco. Inside, we hand squeegee with drop cloths, and cotton covered ladders for two story rooms. Patios and pool decks are cleaned by hand, and stucco and limestone are soft washed only.
A 5,000 square foot home is about $500 for exterior windows. Plan on four to five hours outside and about two and a half hours inside.

faq.q: How do you handle the gate?
faq.a: Send us the code or the contact who opens it. We text on our way and on arrival if needed.

faq.q: Is the Reserve too far for you?
faq.a: It is the far northwest edge of our area, so we plan the visit. Lead time is usually within two weeks, and booking with neighbors helps us group stops.

faq.q: What does a big lake home cost?
faq.a: Exterior windows are about $0.10 per square foot, so a 5,000 square foot home is about $500. Cleaning inside and out in The Reserve at Lake Travis is $15 per window. Screens are $5 each.

faq.q: Can you clean glass near the water or pool?
faq.a: Water fed poles work from a safe distance, so we do not need to get at the edge. We tell you ahead if a window needs a different approach.

faq.q: Do you also clean patios and pool decks?
faq.a: Yes, by hand so they do not get soaked. Concrete flatwork is $0.18 per square foot and pavers are $0.25, with a $250 minimum.
